content.text: Fixed the real bug: `TranslationMemory.save()` calls `refreshCoverageReports`, which reads `i18n.config.json` — the test's blanket `existsSync` mock made it try to `JSON.parse` the markdown fixture and throw, silently failing the whole pipeline (masquerading as a `vi.waitFor` timeout). Updated [build-api-locales.test.ts](docs/scripts/build-api-locales.test.ts) so `existsSync` returns `false` for that path, letting `refreshCoverageReports` early-return as intended.
